about: rasya-taste-v4.3 hero recipes (references/hero-recipes.md; agent R). A hero template (assets/layout/hero-<id>.html, dealt by deal.mjs) is only the frame; a recipe is the visual that goes in it, rebuilt from 1-3 named reference heroes with our own assets: the technique and the composition are taken, never the reference's words, logo, pictures or colours. scripts/hero.mjs deals one recipe that fits the page's kind and its dealt template, away from recent pages, product-UI at most about one page in five. Each recipe lives in assets/layout/recipes/<id>/: recipe.html (a working demo on the kit's tokens in a hero template), recipe.js and recipe.css (the mountable module), demo-*.svg (drawn stand-ins for the demo only).

fields.refs: the reference heroes the recipe rebuilds: name, the fold screenshot under references/visual/hero/ (960 wide), the motion strip when the reference moves, and what to take from it
fields.kinds: the page kinds it may be dealt to (SKILL.md section 1): software, gaming, tech, product, service, editorial; a place is never dealt a recipe (its hero is printed: the place's own photograph)
fields.heroTemplates: the hero-<id> frames it fits (heroes.json ids) and, in mount, the slot it fills in each
fields.technique: three | webgl | canvas | css | video | image. three and webgl (and canvas) are tech only: software, gaming, tech
fields.oneEffect: true: the recipe is the page's one effect (effects-usage.md Tech budget); deal no other effect, scene or WebGL moment beside it
fields.interaction: what the visitor does to it and what it does by itself; every self-moving part rests under reduced motion and carries the kit's pause button past 5 s
fields.still: what shows before the live layer, under reduced motion, on a phone, without WebGL and on kind other
fields.perf: cost (low | medium | high), WebGL contexts, the JavaScript it loads, how it renders
fields.needs: what the brief must really have, as heroes.json writes it (a|b: either): ui (the client's screens or kit fragments rewritten to its names), object (cut-outs or renders of the client's own product), photo (photographs: the client's, else stand-ins from photos.mjs search, or generated pictures of the world, never of the client's product or people), film (the client's film), datum (a real figure from the brief), logo (the client's mark as SVG). Empty: nothing beyond the copy
fields.subjects: words of the brief that make the recipe fit (hero.mjs reads --brief): required true means it is dealt only when one of them is in the brief or in --subject
fields.assets: the pictures the recipe needs, for photos.mjs recipe-assets (agent A2): { slot, kind, style, prompt, count, ratio, transparent, optional }. style is a preset id of assets/ui/image-styles.json (one style a page; illustration-scene's clay variant takes 3d-clay). kind is illustration | photo | cutout | texture | render | video | model3d. The prompt's {product}, {audience}, {world} and {palette} are filled from the brief; no words in any picture. Each asset element in the mount carries data-rr-slot="<slot>" (hero.mjs check counts them)
fields.mount: the markup, the slot per template, and the files to link

three.load: lazily, once a page, inside rtMotion.onReady (recipe-kit.js loadThree)

shared.head: <link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/layout/recipes/_shared/recipes.css"> after assets/layout/layout.css, then the recipe's own recipe.css
shared.glCap: window.__tpGl / window.__tpGlMax (default 4), the same count fx.js, the scenes and the objects keep

recipes.name: Wireframe or point-cloud figure
recipes.idea: One figure or object drawn as a glowing wireframe (or a point cloud) on a dark ground beside the words: the subject itself as data, turning to look at the visitor.

refs.name: Yellow3D
refs.take: a bold h1 on the left, one large wireframe bust on the right cut by the hero's foot, one accent colour on black, nothing else in the hero

recipes.interaction: the head turns toward the pointer (yaw 0.55, pitch 0.16, damped about the neck, the shoulders stay); the figure draws itself crown to chest once on load (1.4 s); the gaze lowers as the hero scrolls away; nothing moves at rest (renders on demand)
recipes.still: an SVG of the same procedural figure, drawn by recipe.js from the same geometry and camera with the back lines left out, in the page's accent: shown first, kept under reduced motion, on a phone, on no WebGL or when the page's four contexts are taken

perf.render: on demand: a frame only while the pose is settling; about 4,600 points rewritten a frame

variants.points: a point cloud on the same surface

slots.photo: as the layer: add hero__bg to the mount, data-calm="left" on the section, a dark hero
slots.statement: add rr--layer, first child of the section; the figure stands right of centre

mount.attrs: data-rr-shape="model" data-rr-src="<a .glb the client owns or a CC0 one>" data-rr-slot="figure" for the client's own model; data-rr-place auto|centre|right; data-rr-scroll off
mount.ground: a dark hero on tech: the page's dark palette or .ground-inverse on the section; the lines are --accent, the ground --bg
